def answer_query(image, query):
    # Initialize the ImagePatch object
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    # Split the query into object and color
    color, object_name = query.split()

    # Find the patches of the object
    object_patches = image_patch.find(object_name)

    # If the object is not found, return a message
    if not object_patches:
        return f"The {object_name} was not found in the image."

    # Filter patches by color
    colored_object_patches = [patch for patch in object_patches if patch.verify_property(object_name, color)]

    # If no patches are found, return a message
    if not colored_object_patches:
        return f"No {color} {object_name} was found in the image."

    # Return the answer
    return f"A {color} {object_name} was found in the image."
